title: A query that sorts before the first suffix underflows mid - 1
body:
`SufrSearch::suffix_search_first` and `suffix_search_last` in `libsufr/src/sufr_search.rs` recurse on `low..=mid - 1` when the query compares less than the suffix at `mid`. When `mid` is 0 that subtraction underflows.

`mid` reaches 0 with a `Less` comparison when the query sorts before the suffix at rank 0. That suffix is normally the sentinel `$`, so any query starting with a byte below `$`, such as a space, `!` or `#`, should reach it. Debug builds panic. In release builds `high` becomes `usize::MAX`, the next `get_suffix` returns `None`, and the `?` turns that into "not found". The release result is correct by accident.

Found by reading the code. Not reproduced.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text: At cff9fb6 the sites are `first_match` (`search.rs:194`) and `last_match` (`search.rs:227`). `sufr locate data/inputs/1.sufr ' '` panics with "attempt to subtract with overflow" at `search.rs:194:44` in a debug build.
